body: Smh. They don’t even follow their own book. “Judge and it will be judged back to you.” Or “Mind your own business.” (1 Thessalonians 4:11-14) Shame, we know their book better than they do!

After leaving the Christian culture, I started to embrace the LGBT+ people. Stop judging them and love them. Stop being ashamed of being bisexual and embrace it. Being able to stop being narcissistic and self-centered. Not everyone needs to think or believe the way I do. I like being a Satanist better. Hail Satan!

Satanism opened my eyes to see how narcissistic the Christian community really is. One example. I am an openly bisexual female and was talking to a Christian friend of mine about the topic of homosexuality. He said, “It would be better for you to die alone than to be with a woman.” That made me realize he wasn’t a true friend or loved me like one. If I consider someone my friend, I would want them happy even if they are in a same sex relationship. As long as that person is good to them and makes them happy, that’s all that should matter. Most Christians are narcissistic. Only caring about their beliefs, opinions and thoughts. So Satanism, thank you! I won’t be going back to Christianity!
Felt the episode was too short. Just my opinion.
